findings.title: Plain HTTP permits tampering with shared levels, uploads, and applet progress
findings.code_excerpt:
public final static String HIGHSCORE_GETPHP = "http://www.apo-games.de/apoNotSoSimple/get_highscore.php";
	public final static String HIGHSCORE_SAVEPHP = "http://www.apo-games.de/apoNotSoSimple/save_highscore.php";
findings.entry_point: The game automatically requests the shared-level response from ApoNotSoSimplePanel.init (apoNotSoSimple/game/ApoNotSoSimplePanel.java:92). Editor-controlled level data and metadata enter the upload path at ApoNotSoSimpleEditor.mouseButtonFunction (apoNotSoSimple/game/ApoNotSoSimpleEditor.java:286-288). In applet mode, a progress value comes from cookies.php at ApoNotSoSimplePanel.java:94-99.
findings.sink: Network bytes cross URLConnection.getOutputStream/getInputStream in org/apogames/help/ApoHighscore.java:77-86,122-127 and 150-167; applet progress crosses HttpURLConnection streams in org/apogames/help/ApoHelp.java:424-436 and 452-465.
findings.data_path: Desktop: ApoNotSoSimpleMain.main (apoNotSoSimple/ApoNotSoSimpleMain.java:18-33) -> ApoNotSoSimplePanel.init (:53-107) -> ApoNotSoSimpleUserLevels.loadHighscore/load (apoNotSoSimple/game/ApoNotSoSimpleUserLevels.java:35-59) -> ApoHighscore.load (org/apogames/help/ApoHighscore.java:141-185) -> ApoNotSoSimpleUserLevels.getLevel (:123-147). Upload: editor action (:286-288) -> ApoHighscore.save (:69-128). Applet: ApoNotSoSimpleApplet.init (apoNotSoSimple/ApoNotSoSimpleApplet.java:39-49) -> Panel.init (:94-99) -> ApoHelp.loadData (:446-473), with saves from Panel.setMaxLevel (:223-227) -> ApoHelp.saveData (:419-444).
findings.attack_scenario: A network attacker runs an intercepting proxy or controls DNS for the HTTP request. They return a syntactically valid five-line record containing an altered tile string, username, level name, description, and solution; when the player opens User Levels, the attacker-controlled content is parsed and played. The attacker can also observe or alter editor uploads. Against the legacy applet, returning 30 from cookies.php makes setMaxLevel unlock all 31 built-in level buttons. This yields content and progression integrity compromise, not host code execution.
findings.preconditions: ApoConstants.B_ONLINE is true by default (org/apogames/ApoConstants.java:16), and the endpoint must be reachable or attacker-routed. The attacker must control the server or network path. Progress forgery additionally requires the JApplet entry point, whose HTTP base is defined at apoNotSoSimple/ApoNotSoSimpleConstants.java:14.
findings.validation_plan: Run the game with JVM HTTP proxy properties pointing to a local mock proxy. For get_highscore.php, answer with one well-formed record whose first line consists of layer count 1 plus 30 two-digit tile codes, including one 02 player and one 09 finish; follow it with attacker username, level-name, description, and solution lines. Open User Levels and confirm those values and tiles appear. Separately capture an editor upload to confirm readable form fields. For applet mode, answer cookies.php with 30 and confirm levels 1-31 render and can be selected.

findings.title: Unbounded server record count feeds quadratic insertion sorts
findings.entry_point: An attacker-controlled response body from get_highscore.php is fetched automatically during ApoNotSoSimplePanel.init (apoNotSoSimple/game/ApoNotSoSimplePanel.java:92).
findings.sink: ApoHighscore.load retains every response line without a count limit (org/apogames/help/ApoHighscore.java:167-183), then ApoNotSoSimpleUserLevels.sort allocates int[3][recordCount] and performs two nested ArrayList insertion sorts (apoNotSoSimple/game/ApoNotSoSimpleUserLevels.java:65-105).
findings.data_path: Panel.init (:92) -> UserLevels.loadHighscore (:35-42) -> UserLevels.load (:53-59) -> ApoHighscore.load (:141-185) -> five growing ArrayLists -> UserLevels.sort (:65-105). No user interaction is needed to start this background path.
findings.attack_scenario: A malicious server or HTTP interceptor returns a very large but structurally complete set of five-line records. All strings remain resident, and reverse-sorted usernames and level names force repeated insertion and array shifting. CPU and heap consumption can freeze the game or exhaust the shared JVM, giving a remote denial of service without relying on malformed records.
findings.preconditions: The default online startup request must reach the attacker-controlled response, and the response must be large enough for the victim's CPU and heap limits.
findings.validation_plan: Use a local HTTP proxy and return 50,000 complete five-line records with reverse-sorted username and level-name lines. Launch with a constrained heap such as -Xmx64m. Record the load thread's CPU time and heap; prolonged sorting, OutOfMemoryError, or an unresponsive game confirms the issue. Keep all records complete to isolate this finding from ApoNotSoSimple-03.

findings.title: Partial five-line response nulls level state and crashes the game thread
findings.entry_point: The attacker-controlled line stream returned by get_highscore.php enters ApoHighscore.load at org/apogames/help/ApoHighscore.java:167-170.
findings.sink: A partial record reaches unchecked parallel-list indexing at apoNotSoSimple/game/ApoNotSoSimpleUserLevels.java:101-103; its exception causes highscore=null at :60-62, and a later User Levels click dereferences it outside the inner parser try at :108-115.
findings.data_path: ApoHighscore.load assigns lines by i % 5 but returns true even when the final record is incomplete (org/apogames/help/ApoHighscore.java:170-185) -> UserLevels.load calls sort (:53-59) -> sortList.get(0) fails for missing username or level-name lists (:101-103) -> catch sets highscore null (:60-62) -> menu action ApoNotSoSimpleMenu.java:92-93 -> Panel.setUserGame at ApoNotSoSimplePanel.java:160-161 -> UserLevels.getLevel dereferences highscore at :112. ApoSubGame.run has no enclosing exception handler (org/apogames/ApoSubGame.java:94-139).
findings.attack_scenario: The server or HTTP interceptor sends exactly one line and closes the response. The loader accepts it as a level-only partial record, sorting fails and silently nulls the singleton reference. When the player clicks User Levels, a NullPointerException escapes the game loop and stops further input and render updates, producing a deterministic remote denial of service.
findings.preconditions: The online response must be attacker-controlled and contain 1-4 trailing lines modulo five; the player must click User Levels after the asynchronous load finishes.
findings.validation_plan: Point the JVM at a local mock HTTP proxy, answer get_highscore.php with the single line "1\n", then EOF. Wait for the loader thread and click User Levels. A NullPointerException from ApoNotSoSimpleUserLevels.getLevel near line 112 followed by a stopped ApoSubGame thread confirms the full path.

findings.title: Dormant URLClassLoader instantiates caller-selected code
findings.entry_point: There is no stock-game entry point: the public constructor accepts path and classname at org/apogames/help/ApoClassLoader.java:19-21, but the whole-tree reference scan found no construction or getMyClass call outside this class.
findings.sink: URLClassLoader.loadClass followed by Class.newInstance at org/apogames/help/ApoClassLoader.java:69-75 executes the selected class initializer and constructor.
findings.data_path: Theoretical only: constructor path and classname (:19-21) -> getMyClass -> local File URL when B_APPLET is false or arbitrary URL when true (:62-69) -> loadClass (:73) -> newInstance (:75). No untrusted network response, local file, chooser selection, or command-line argument reaches this method in the shipped variant.
findings.attack_scenario: This cannot be triggered in the stock game. If an external caller or future clone wires a user-selected directory or URL and class name into this helper, the attacker places a class there; getMyClass loads it and its constructor executes with the game's JVM permissions, yielding arbitrary code execution.
findings.preconditions: New integration code or an external harness must call ApoClassLoader. Remote URL loading additionally requires ApoConstants.B_APPLET=true; desktop mode loads from a local filesystem URL.
findings.validation_plan: For a proof of the dormant sink, compile a test class whose constructor creates a marker file, place it under a temporary class-root directory, and invoke new ApoClassLoader(tempRoot, "test.Payload").getMyClass() from a harness. Marker creation proves execution. Then confirm the unmodified game never invokes the harness or helper.

notes: The supplied source root contains the project beneath the literal nested prefix Users/eliahilse/Documents/GitHub/B/apogames/Java/ApoNotSoSimple/, so every reported path is relative to the supplied root. All 57 files are Java and were covered by whole-tree source, sink, and reference scans, with numbered inspection of each relevant flow. No ObjectInputStream/readObject, System.load/loadLibrary, native declaration, credential, or corpus save/replay extension was found. The generic ApoIO disk/URL base (org/apogames/ApoIO.java:31-105), ApoCopy file helper (org/apogames/help/ApoCopy.java:27-74), and JFileChooser getter (apoNotSoSimple/ApoNotSoSimpleComponent.java:66-72) have no subclasses or call sites here, so no untrusted local-file path reaches them. ApoHelp.getMd5Digest defines MD5 at org/apogames/help/ApoHelp.java:301-310 but has no call site, so it is not an active integrity check. A JApplet entry point exists at apoNotSoSimple/ApoNotSoSimpleApplet.java:18-49; its reachable HTTP progress flow is included in ApoNotSoSimple-01 and requires a legacy applet runtime.
